def count_ways(n, k):
    # Initialize dp table
    dp = [[0] * (k + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    dp[0][0] = 1
    
    # Fill the dp table
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in range(k + 1):
            if j == 0:
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j] * (n - i + 1) % MOD
            else:
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j] * (n - i + 1) % MOD
                if i <= k:
                    dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i - 1][j - 1]) % MOD
    
    return dp[n][k]
